copy.tagline: 通过深度访谈与模糊门控进行智能评估
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要进行深度对话式评估并自动触发后续操作
copy.tagline_en: Conduct deep interviews with ambiguity gating for smart evaluation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need deep conversational evaluation with automated follow-up

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会对你的模糊想法进行苏格拉底式深度提问。它每次只问一个最不清晰的问题，根据回答计算模糊度分数，只有分数低于阈值才会继续执行。
howto.when: 当你说“deep interview”、“interview me”、“ask me everything”等关键词，或者对想法不确定、想避免误解时触发。

say.text: 请对我进行深度采访，帮我梳理这个想法。
say.note: Claude会开始提问并计算清晰度分数。

say.text: 我不确定这个功能怎么做，采访我一下。
say.note: Claude会针对最模糊的维度提问。

say.text: 帮我问清楚所有需求，不要假设任何东西。
say.note: Claude会使用苏格拉底式追问。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will conduct a Socratic deep interview on vague ideas. It asks one question at a time targeting the weakest clarity dimension, scores ambiguity after each answer, and proceeds to execution only when ambiguity falls below a threshold.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says "deep interview", "interview me", "ask me everything" etc., or has an unclear idea and wants thorough requirements gathering before execution.

say_en.text: Interview me on this vague idea.
Ask me everything about my project.
say_en.note: Claude will probe assumptions and score clarity.

say_en.text: Don't assume anything, interview me thoroughly.
say_en.note: Claude will iterate until ambiguity is low.
